allowed_symmetries: D4 reflection across the real axis

edges.rule: Connect two Gaussian-prime representative vertices when their Euclidean distance in Z[i] is less than or equal to threshold.

nodes.description: One deterministic Gaussian-prime representative for each of the 15 supersingular primes.
nodes.selection_rule: For p=2 use (1,1); for p congruent to 3 mod 4 use (p,0); for p congruent to 1 mod 4 use the lexicographically first positive pair (a,b) with a^2 + b^2 = p.

non_claims: not a proof of Monstrous Moonshine
not a Lean-certified theorem inside this repository
not a continuum, quantum, gravity, or field-theory result
